name: Universal Logistics - Chillicothe Contract Logistics Warehouse - Chillicothe IL

fieldNotes.siteResolution: No street address in roster. Resolved to the large Caterpillar parts/distribution warehouse on E Cedar Hills Drive, Chillicothe IL (~40.8482, -89.5535) — web search identified a Caterpillar 'General Warehousing and Storage' facility at 2800 E Cedar Hills Drive handling parts-distribution logistics; the Cedar Hills residential subdivision sits immediately north of the building, matching the address. This is the type of pick/pack/sequencing/inventory facility Universal Logistics operates for Caterpillar in Chillicothe. The exact Universal-operated sub-area within the Caterpillar Chillicothe campus is not crisply confirmed — medium confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth visible at the road edge in Street View along E Cedar Hills Drive — the rural campus warehouse has open driveway access from the public road into the parking/apron area. Classed truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth observed at any entrance. false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Very large warehouse (~350m x 200m footprint). Dock apron with trailers backed in observed on the east face; estimate 50+ dock doors total across the building given its size — flagged as an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer rows parked along the east access road plus outdoor laydown/material storage on the east side — dedicated trailer/material drop area present.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: A second large warehouse building sits immediately south of the main DC — campus layout.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; the Caterpillar Chillicothe campus is road-served at this building. false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town rural setting — cornfields directly across E Cedar Hills Drive, farmland surrounding. Rural.
